purpose: Factor the local v8.5.2 current amplitude exactly, identify its optimal rank-one character decomposition, derive a global 5m-sign full-support linear kernel, and prove that this dual kernel returns to the original 12-state quotient rather than constituting a hidden polynomial solver.

two_linear_factor_theorem.name: C4_CURRENT_TWO_LINEAR_FACTOR_IDENTITY
two_linear_factor_theorem.statement: For every k in F3^6, h(k.VP)+h(k.VM)=h(k.a)h(k.b). Therefore F6(k)=delta[sum_i k_i=0] h(k.a)h(k.b).
two_linear_factor_theorem.proof: Write h(t)=omega^t+omega^{-t}. Since VP=a+b and VM=a-b, h(x+y)+h(x-y)=(omega^x+omega^{-x})(omega^y+omega^{-y})=h(x)h(y).

optimal_cp_rank_theorem.name: CP_RANK_F6_EQUALS_12
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.upper_bound: F6=(1/3) sum_{c in F3,alpha,beta in {+1,-1}} omega^{(c*1+alpha*a+beta*b).k}, giving twelve rank-one character terms.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.wire_state_identity: The twelve exponent vectors c*1+alpha*a+beta*b are exactly the twelve quotient wire states c*1+s*v_q under alpha=s,beta=s*q.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.lower_bound: The exact 3|3 flattening-rank profile is rank6:4, rank9:8, rank12:8. Hence one flattening has matrix rank 12, so every CP decomposition has at least twelve terms.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.conclusion: CP-rank(F6)=12 and the canonical quotient-state character decomposition is rank-optimal.

global_full_support_kernel.setting: A closed loopless network of m six-port wires whose 6m ports are paired into E=3m oriented splice edges. Let B be the signed GF(3) incidence matrix and K=ker(B).
global_full_support_kernel.row_system: R has E coordinate rows plus two embedded local rows a,b for every wire.
global_full_support_kernel.identity: If N=#{s in {+1,-1}^{E+2m}: R^T s belongs to row(B)}, then Z=3^{m-rank(B)}N. For c connected components, rank(B)=m-c and therefore Z=3^c N.
global_full_support_kernel.proof: Expand every h factor into two additive characters and use exact character orthogonality on K.

dual_return_bijection.statement: Writing the row-space membership as R^T s=B^T lambda produces one GF(3) potential lambda_v per wire. The induced six port colours lambda_v-alpha_v*a-beta_v*b are exactly the twelve quotient wire states, while each edge sign gamma_e in {+1,-1} enforces precisely the exposed-port NEQ constraint. Lambda is free only by one additive constant per connected component, explaining the factor 3^c.
dual_return_bijection.anti_loop: The compact 5m-sign linear presentation is an exact dual coordinate form of the same quotient CSP. Its existence is not a polynomial-time decision algorithm; generic full-support/syndrome compression is already firewalled by v5.2-v5.6.

two_wire_exhaustive_control.identity: DIRECT_COUNT=3*FULL_SUPPORT_N for every one of the 720 closures.

verified_stdout: 12 character exponent vectors equal the 12 quotient wire states

positive: The local transition expansion factors exactly into two scalar h factors.
The exact local CP rank is twelve.
A polynomial-size full-support linear normal form exists.
anti_loop: That normal form dual-returns to the original 12-state CSP and therefore is not a complexity reduction by itself.
Do not revisit Fourier/full-support/syndrome coordinate changes without a new source-order theorem.
algorithmic_consequence.remaining_constructive_target: Exploit Hamiltonian occurrence order globally in a representation that is not bijectively just the same 12-state quotient.
